### Overcoming Unfair Treatment
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-october-16-2021.html
Passage: Zephaniah 3:5
Points:
- Inviting God to search and cleanse the hidden places where anger, bitterness, and grudges linger.
- Releasing the desire for self-pity, revenge, and keeping score over personal mistreatment.
- Resting in the unchanging righteousness and justice of God when facing unfair circumstances.
- Practicing difficult but necessary forgiveness toward others, even when they never acknowledge their wrongdoing.
- Looking to Christ—who suffered unjustly on our behalf—to receive healing, peace, and renewed hope.
